task_text: 在给定视频中定位符合以下描述的片段，给出秒数范围及证据；说明定位的不确定性：Man walks along water alone on a windy day.
task_text_en: Locate the segment of the given video that matches the following description; give its time range in seconds with supporting evidence, and state the uncertainty of the localization: Man walks along water alone on a windy day.

requirements.text: 符合描述的片段在视频中的起止时间（秒）
requirements.text_en: Start and end time (seconds) of the segment in the video that matches the description

requirements.text: 支持定位的画面依据：片段内以及边界两侧的帧所显示的内容
requirements.text_en: Visual grounds for the localization: what the frames inside the segment and on both sides of its boundaries show

requirements.text: 定位精度与边界的不确定范围（未检查的区间不当作不符合）
requirements.text_en: Localization precision and the uncertain range of the boundaries (unexamined intervals are not treated as non-matching)

required_evidence.description: 给定视频的抽帧（片段内与边界两侧）

notes: r0g 扩案例（2026-10-15 23:26:46，walker_d2_cases.py）：标注片段 [[70, 86]]（视频 150 秒，源 YouTube th92F6_caOM 的 660.0–810.0 s）；family 按源视频号分组。
